formative_worksheets.title: The Build and Match Check
formative_worksheets.when_to_use: After Lesson 3, before Lesson 4. Quick mid-unit check (10 min) to confirm E1.2 (build) and E1.3 (matching halves) before extending into position language.
formative_worksheets.purpose: Standalone formative check that probes 3D building and symmetry recognition.
formative_worksheets.student_learning_goal: I can build and find matching halves.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can build and find matching halves.
header.character_watermark: Trekker Tig in the top-right corner with a clipboard. Small (~1.5in tall). References blueprint.recurring_characters.

prompts.prompt: Look at the structure. Name the 2D shapes you can see.
prompts.visual_layout: A 3D structure (cube + pyramid). Below: writing lines for shapes.

image_placeholders.description: A 3D structure illustration for a Grade 1 formative check. Cube on the bottom with pyramid on top — a simple cabin-like shape, ~3in × 3in. B&W with light shading. Below the structure, blank writing lines for the child to list shapes.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image FORM_Q1_STRUCTURE at Prompt 1: instructions ask the child to find 2D shapes. Keywords name the visual elements.

prompts.answer_key: Squares (cube faces) + triangles (pyramid faces). Ideally 4-5 of each visible from the front.

prompts.prompt: Circle the shapes that have MATCHING HALVES.
prompts.visual_layout: 6 shapes in a 2x3 grid. Some symmetric (heart, square, butterfly), some not (F, asymmetric blob, comma).

image_placeholders.description: A 2x3 grid of 6 shapes for a Grade 1 formative check, B&W line art. Top row: heart, square, F. Bottom row: butterfly, asymmetric blob, comma. Each shape ~1.5in. Suitable for circling.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image FORM_Q2_SHAPES at Prompt 2: instructions ask the child to circle matching halves. Keywords name the criteria.

prompts.answer_key: CIRCLED: heart, square, butterfly. NOT CIRCLED: F, asymmetric blob, comma.

prompts.prompt: How are you feeling about building and matching? Circle the face.

image_placeholders.description: Three round face icons for a Grade 1 formative check. Smile, neutral, frown. Each ~1.5in.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image FORM_Q3_FACES at Prompt 3: instructions ask the child to circle a face. Keywords name the visual.

prompts.answer_key: Open. Use alongside Q1 and Q2.

formative_worksheets.teacher_notes: Administer between Lesson 3 and Lesson 4. Print one per child.

reflection_sheet.title: My Map It, Move It! Reflection
reflection_sheet.student_learning_goal: I can think about what I learned this week.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can think about what I learned this week.
header.character_watermark: Tig and Coco in the top-right corner with a Junior Spatial Detective certificate. References blueprint.recurring_characters.

prompts.prompt: How do you feel about being a Spatial Detective? Circle one.

image_placeholders.description: Three rating ovals for a Grade 1 reflection. 1, 2, 3 stars with labels.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: REF_STARS at Prompt 1: keywords name the rating and role.

prompts.prompt: Did you do these things? Circle YES or NO.

image_placeholders.description: A 4-row YES/NO table for a Grade 1 reflection.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: REF_YN_TABLE at Prompt 2: keywords name the response options.

image_placeholders.description: A bordered rectangle ~5in × 1.8in for a Grade 1 reflection sheet. Above: 'My favourite spatial activity was...'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: REF_FAV_BOX at Prompt 3: keywords name the focus.

prompts.prompt: The trickiest part for me was...

image_placeholders.description: A bordered rectangle for a Grade 1 reflection. Above: 'The trickiest part for me was...'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: REF_TRICKY_BOX at Prompt 4: keyword matches the prompt.

prompts.prompt: Next time, I want to try...

image_placeholders.description: A bordered rectangle for a Grade 1 reflection. Above: 'Next time, I want to try...'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: REF_NEXT_BOX at Prompt 5: keywords name the focus.

reflection_sheet.teacher_notes: Hand out at the end of Lesson 5. Children may need scribe support for prompts 3-5.
